description:
Bulk-ingest a Pandas DataFrame into Apache Doris via Stream Load.

Example:

    ```yaml
    type: dagster_community_components.DataframeToDorisComponent
    attributes:
      asset_name: doris_orders_load
      upstream_asset_key: orders_clean
      table: orders                          # Doris table (database from resource)
      host_env_var: DORIS_FE_HOST            # OR use resource_key
      http_port: 8030
      username_env_var: DORIS_USER
      password_env_var: DORIS_PASSWORD
      database: analytics
      mode: append                           # 'append' or 'replace' (DELETE+INSERT pattern)
      format: csv
    ```

host_env_var.label: Host Env Var
host_env_var.description: Env var with Doris FE host.

ssl.label: SSL
ssl.description: Use https for the Stream Load endpoint.

columns.label: Columns
columns.description: Optional explicit column list (must match Doris table column order). If unset, DataFrame column order is used.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: Load mode: 'append' (default — Stream Load appends), or 'replace' (DELETE rows matching a predicate first, then Stream Load — requires replace_predicate).

replace_predicate.label: Replace Predicate
replace_predicate.description: SQL WHERE clause for replace mode (e.g. "event_date = '2026-05-27'").

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog. Auto-inferred from component name if empty.

partition_column.label: Partition Column
partition_column.description: When set AND the asset is partitioned, appends this column to every row with the current partition key as its value. Enables the single-table + partition_column analytics pattern (WHERE partition_date = '2025-01-15') without needing per-partition tables. Prefer this over `{partition_key}` templating in the `table:` field for warehouse sinks — analytics queries stay clean. See docs/partition_patterns.md.
